scope: Actual loopback SMTP with STARTTLS, certificate validation and AUTH against a disposable aiosmtpd server; no external mail or inbox delivery claim.
delivery: Accepted by the local TLS/authenticated mailbox; envelope, subject and reset URL checked without retaining the token.
verified: Authenticated STARTTLS delivery with locally trusted certificate
One-time reset and session revocation followed by login with changed password
Unknown account does not send mail and gets the same success response
Each failure preserves the previous reset token/session and does not commit a reset-request audit event
